U_tip.note: Real Abaqus smoke baseline for generated C3D8R solid model with a -1 N U2 tip-center load. Euler-Bernoulli estimate is ~1.9e-3 mm and is used only as a sanity check.

MISES_MAX.note: Real ODB KPI baseline from integration-point Mises values for the generated coarse solid mesh, not an extrapolated surface stress.
